content.value: Water flows at a velocity 1m/s over a flat plate of length 0.6m. The water temperature is (18) 350K. In the laminar and turbulent regions, local convection coefficients are described by, $\bf h _ { \mathrm { { l a m } } } ( \bf x ) = \delta C _ { \mathrm { { l a m } } } x ^ { - 0 . 5 } ; h _ { \mathrm { { t u r b } } } ( \bf x ) = \delta C _ { \mathrm { { t u r b } } } x ^ { - 0 . 2 }$ . Where x has units of metér.

At $3 5 0 \mathrm { K , ~ C _ { l a m } = 4 7 7 ~ W / \left( m ^ { 1 . 5 } . ~ K \right) , ~ C _ { t u r b } = 3 6 0 0 ~ W / \left( m ^ { 1 . 8 } . ~ K \right) }$ . Determine the average convection coefficient over the entire plate.
